items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: The interviewee discusses Raymond Brown and Bat Brown, but 'Twat' is only mentioned as the person who provided information to the interviewer ('Twat just told us...'). The interviewee does not describe a personal relationship with Twat.

ctx.x: There were so many different fellas I played with. Oh, Raymond Brown.

Do you remember anything about Raymond Brown's band? It was Twat just told us a few minutes ago that he played his first job with Raymond Brown. Yeah. And he was a trombonist, I know. I think he was some relative of H.E. Miners, wasn't he? I think once had a picture that H.E. loaned us. Well, I know. Do you remember anything about him? Because he's dead now, I understand. Yeah, I understand, yeah.

And his brother was a trumpet player, Bat. Bat Brown. We used to call him Bat Brown. And we used to go to rehearsal way uptown. And he used to come down here all the time. He was, this fella was well known. He had plenty of little jobs. He played plenty of jobs with him. How did he play? What type of trombone was his name? He was a good trombone player. Like anybody else that you can think of playing today that we might- Oh, he played all the style of his gym down there.
